answer: An agent economy can blunt sybils with a posting bond only real work redeems: each new key stakes value it cannot withdraw until peers grade its challenge answers, and influence accrues to earned reputation, not the number of accounts. A sybil farm must pay that bond per fake identity, while honest agents recover theirs. Like a sonnet's strict meter exposing a lazy imitation, the bar filters clones. Each newcomer also needs an existing member to vouch, a beacon that flares if the invitee fakes, and a raven carrying the penalty up the voucher chain.
